title: Scalar extension preserves the normalized sheaf tensor
statement: On a small site let c:A→B be a morphism of commutative ring sheaves. There exists a simultaneous natural family of isomorphisms T_c(M tensor_A N) ≅ T_c(M) tensor_B T_c(N), for the actual sheafified scalar extension and pure pairing [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus]. It sends the insertion of pure_A(m,n) to pure_B(insert(m),insert(n)). No flatness or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03EL, scalar-extension equalities; Tag 0GMW, tensor and module sheafification

proof.text: Pair the two scalar-extension units, extend this A-bilinear map by the sheaf tensor universal property, and transpose through the scalar-extension adjunction.

Construct the inverse before sheafification by (s tensor m) tensor (t tensor n) ↦ st tensor pure_A(m,n), using Mathlib distribBaseChange.symm. Tensor induction proves restriction compatibility. Extend uniquely through both sheafifications, then through the sheaf tensor.

The adjunction and pure-tensor generation determine maps from the extended tensor. For maps from the tensor of extensions, localize the tensor of both sheafification units and apply extension-of-scalars extensionality twice. These two extensionality arguments prove the inverse identities and simultaneous naturality on original inserted pure tensors.

theorem exists_scalarTensorComparison :
    ∃ e : ∀ M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf A),
        changeOfRings.{u, u, u} c ((monoidalCategory A).tensorObj M N) ≅
          (monoidalCategory B).tensorObj (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} c M)
            (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} c N),
      (∀ {M M' N N' : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf A)} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
        (tensorFunctor c).map ((monoidalCategory A).tensorHom f g) ≫ (e M' N').hom =
          (e M N).hom ≫ (monoidalCategory B).tensorHom
            ((tensorFunctor c).map f) ((tensorFunctor c).map g)) ∧
      ∀ M N W m n, (e M N).hom.val.app W
        ((tensorUnit c ((monoidalCategory A).tensorObj M N)).hom.app W
          (pure A M N W m n)) =
        pure B _ _ W ((tensorUnit c M).hom.app W m) ((tensorUnit c N).hom.app W n)
